papers.title: Revealing Geography-Driven Signals in Zone-Level Claim Frequency Models: An Empirical Study using Environmental and Visual Predictors
papers.abstract: Geographic context is often consider relevant to motor insurance risk, yet public actuarial datasets provide limited location identifiers, constraining how this information can be incorporated and evaluated in claim-frequency models. This study examines how geographic information from alternative data sources can be incorporated into actuarial models for Motor Third Party Liability (MTPL) claim prediction under such constraints.   Using the BeMTPL97 dataset, we adopt a zone-level modeling framework and evaluate predictive performance on unseen postcodes. Geographic information is introduced through two channels: environmental indicators from OpenStreetMap and CORINE Land Cover, and orthoimagery released by the Belgian National Geographic Institute for academic use. We evaluate the predictive contribution of coordinates, environmental features, and image embeddings across three baseline models: generalized linear models (GLMs), regularized GLMs, and gradient-boosted trees, while raw imagery is modeled using convolutional neural networks.   Our results show that augmenting actuarial variables with constructed geographic information improves accuracy. Across experiments, both linear and tree-based models benefit most from combining coordinates with environmental features extracted at 5 km scale, while smaller neighborhoods also improve baseline specifications. Generally, image embeddings do not improve performance when environmental features are available; however, when such features are absent, pretrained vision-transformer embeddings enhance accuracy and stability for regularized GLMs. Our results show that the predictive value of geographic information in zone-level MTPL frequency models depends less on model complexity than on how geography is represented, and illustrate that geographic context can be incorporated despite limited individual-level spatial information.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】地理背景通常被认为与机动车保险风险密切相关，然而公共精算数据集中提供的位置标识信息较为有限，这限制了这些信息在理赔频率模型中的整合与评估方式。本研究探讨了在现有约束条件下，如何将来自其他数据源的地理信息纳入机动车第三方责任（MTPL）理赔预测的精算模型中。我们使用BeMTPL97数据集，采用区域级建模框架，并对未见过的邮政编码进行预测性能评估。地理信息的获取途径包括：来自OpenStreetMap和CORINE土地覆盖数据库的环境指标，以及比利时国家地理研究所为学术用途发布的正射影像。我们通过三种基线模型（广义线性模型GLMs、正则化GLMs和梯度提升树）评估了坐标、环境特征及图像嵌入的预测贡献；原始影像数据则通过卷积神经网络进行处理。研究结果表明，将构建的地理信息添加到精算变量中可以提高预测准确性。在所有实验中，线性和基于树的模型从将坐标与5公里尺度提取的环境特征相结合中获益最大；较小的邻域范围也能提升基线模型的性能。总体而言，当环境特征可用时，图像嵌入对预测性能的提升作用不明显；但在缺乏环境特征的情况下，预训练的视觉变换器嵌入能够增强正则化GLMs的预测准确性和稳定性。我们的...。研究方法：实验方法、神经网络。

papers.title: Modeling dependency between operational risk losses and macroeconomic variables using Hidden Markov Models
papers.abstract: Predicting future operational risk losses gives rise to a significant challenge due to the heterogeneous and time-dependent structures present in real-world data. Furthermore, stress test exercises require examining the relationship with operational losses. To capture such relationship, we propose to use an extension of Hidden Markov Models to multivariate observations. This model introduces a third auxiliary variable designed to accommodate the economic covariates in the time-series data. We detail the unique aspects of operational risk data and describe how model calibration is achieved via the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm. Additionally, we provide the calibration results for the various risk-event types and analyze the relevance of the inclusion of the macroeconomic covariates.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】预测未来的运营风险损失是一个重大挑战，因为现实世界数据中存在异构性和时间依赖性结构。此外，压力测试需要研究运营损失与各种因素之间的关系。为捕捉这种关系，我们提出将隐马尔可夫模型（Hidden Markov Model）扩展应用于多变量观测数据。该模型引入了一个第三个辅助变量，用于处理时间序列数据中的经济协变量。我们详细阐述了运营风险数据的独特特征，并介绍了如何通过期望最大化（Expectation-Maximization, EM）算法进行模型校准。同时，我们提供了不同风险事件类型的校准结果，并分析了纳入宏观经济协变量的重要性。。

papers.title: The Role of Efficiency and Revenue Margin In Improving Insurance Company Performance and Sustainability: A Literature Review
papers.venue: Journal of economics, finance and management studies
papers.abstract: This study aims to analyze the role of operational efficiency and revenue margins in improving the performance and sustainability of insurance companies through a literature review approach. The method used is a systematic literature review (SLR), which examines relevant scientific articles indexed in Google Scholar, particularly from selected journals. The selection process is carried out systematically based on inclusion and exclusion criteria, and analyzed using a thematic approach to identify patterns of relationships between variables.The research results show that operational efficiency has a positive relationship with company performance, although efficiency levels fluctuate and are not yet optimal. Revenue margins have also been shown to contribute significantly to company profitability, with most studies demonstrating a positive relationship between margins and performance. Furthermore, efficiency and revenue margins simultaneously play a role in determining company performance and sustainability, although the relationship is not always linear due to external factors such as market competition.The conclusion of this study confirms that the integration of efficiency and revenue margins is a crucial factor in improving performance and maintaining the sustainability of insurance companies. Therefore, companies need to manage both aspects in a balanced manner to achieve optimal and sustainable performance.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本研究旨在通过文献综述的方法，分析运营效率与利润率在提升保险公司绩效和可持续性方面的作用。所采用的方法是系统性文献综述（Systematic Literature Review, SLR），该方法查阅了在Google Scholar上索引的相关科学论文，尤其是来自选定期刊的文章。论文的筛选过程基于明确的纳入和排除标准进行系统化操作，并通过主题分析法来识别变量之间的关联模式。研究结果表明，运营效率与公司绩效之间存在正相关关系，尽管效率水平存在波动且尚未达到最优状态。同时，利润率也被证实对公司的盈利能力具有显著贡献，大多数研究均显示利润率与绩效之间存在正向关联。此外，运营效率和利润率共同影响着公司的绩效与可持续性，但由于市场竞争等外部因素的存在，这种关系并非总是线性的。本研究结论认为，将运营效率与利润率相结合是提升保险公司绩效和维持其可持续性的关键因素。因此，保险公司需要平衡地管理这两个方面，以实现最佳且可持续的绩效表现。。

papers.title: Forecasting Bitcoin price movements using multivariate Hawkes processes and limit order book data
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Forecasting short-term returns of Bitcoin is a key challenge in high-frequency trading, due to the cryptocurrency’s extreme volatility, market microstructure complexity, and non-stationary behavior. Limit Order Book (LOB) data offer a rich source of high-resolution information that can improve predictive models beyond what is possible using price series alone. In this study, we investigate the BTC/USD trading pair and develop two return sign forecasting approaches based on multivariate Hawkes processes (MHP), leveraging LOB event streams collected in real time from a centralized exchange. Our first method integrates an MHP with a Continuous-time Output Error (COE) model to jointly model event timing and return dynamics in irregularly sampled data. The second approach directly forecasts return sign and timing via an extended MHP. Empirical results show that the hybrid MHP–COE pipeline consistently outperforms the pure Hawkes-based model in both prediction accuracy and simulated trading profitability. We also evaluate the methods’ computational efficiency to assess their viability in real-world high-frequency environments.
papers.summary_zh:
【风险管理与衍生品】摘要  
预测比特币的短期收益是高频交易中的一个关键挑战，这主要是由于比特币的极端波动性、市场微观结构的复杂性以及非平稳性行为所致。限价单簿（LOB）数据提供了丰富的、高分辨率的信息，这些信息能够显著提升预测模型的性能，超越仅使用价格序列所能实现的效果。在本研究中，我们以BTC/USD交易对为例，基于多变量霍克斯过程（MHP）开发了两种预测收益方向的方法，并利用从中心化交易所实时收集的LOB事件流来实现预测。第一种方法将MHP与连续时间输出误差（COE）模型相结合，共同模拟不规则采样数据中的事件发生时间和收益动态；第二种方法则直接通过扩展的MHP模型来预测收益方向和时间。实证结果表明，这种混合MHP–COE模型在预测准确性和模拟交易盈利能力方面均显著优于纯霍克斯模型。此外，我们还评估了这些方法的计算效率，以评估其在实际高频交易环境中的可行性。。

papers.title: The Impact of Maternal Education on Early Childhood Development -- by Moriam Khanam, Mohammad Hajizadeh, Casey Warman
papers.abstract: This study leverages exogenous variation from a secondary school stipend program for female students in rural Bangladesh to estimate the causal effect of maternal education on early childhood development. Using data from the 2019 Bangladesh Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey, we find that the five years of stipend eligibility increase mothers' schooling by about one year. Instrumental variable estimates show that an additional year of maternal education improves early childhood development scores by 0.5 points on a scale of 0-10, with gains in overall developmental readiness (7.5 percentage points) and in the literacy–numeracy (7.7  percentage points) and physical (1.9 percentage points) domains. The results are robust across specifications. We also estimate the effects of maternal education on potential mechanisms, including children's nutrition, home learning environment, parenting practices, and use of early childhood education and care. The findings show that improvements in maternal education increase weight-for-age Z-scores, reduce stunting, improve the probability of having toys from shops, and increase the likelihood of an adult household member playing with the child. The positive effects of maternal education on children's developmental outcomes imply the importance of investment in improving educational attainment, particularly for females in low- and middle-income countries.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究利用孟加拉国农村地区针对女学生的中学助学金计划所带来的外生性变化，来评估母亲教育水平对儿童早期发展的影响。通过分析2019年孟加拉国多项指标集群调查的数据，我们发现获得助学金的五年时间使母亲的受教育年限平均增加了约一年。工具变量估计结果显示，母亲受教育年限每增加一年，儿童在0-10分制的早期发展评估得分会上升0.5分，其中整体发展能力（提升7.5个百分点）、读写能力（提升7.7个百分点）以及身体发展能力（提升1.9个百分点）均有所改善。这些结果在不同研究设定下均具有稳定性。我们还探讨了母亲教育对其他相关因素的影响，包括儿童的营养状况、家庭学习环境、育儿方式以及儿童是否能够接受早期教育和保育服务。研究发现，母亲教育水平的提高有助于提升儿童的体重与年龄比Z分数，减少发育迟缓现象，增加儿童从商店购买玩具的可能性，并提高家庭中成人成员与儿童互动的频率。母亲教育对儿童发展结果的积极影响表明，投资于提高教育水平尤为重要，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家中。。研究方法：调查数据、工具变量。

papers.title: Tariffs and the Term Structure of Inflation Expectations -- by Stéphane Auray, Michael B. Devereux, Anthony M. Diercks, Aurélien Eyquem, Joon Kim
papers.abstract:
Inflation expectations derived from financial markets exhibited unprecedented dynamics in 2025: the correlation between one-year inflation swaps and one-year-ahead one-year forward rates turned significantly negative for the first time on record. We show that this decoupling occurred primarily on days when tariff news dominated market pricing, using a two-stage event classification validated by Bloomberg news trends. Standard small open-economy New Keynesian models in which tariffs generate a one-time price-level increase imply positive comovement across horizons and cannot explain this pattern. 
We explain these occurrences through the lens of an amended small open-economy New Keynesian model. Three ingredients prove critical for reproducing the observed negative conditional correlation between spot and forward inflation after tariff shocks: targeting year-on-year inflation, substantial interest-rate inertia, and persistent tariffs. Under empirically plausible calibrations, the model generates a negative correlation conditional on tariff shocks while preserving a positive unconditional correlation, suggesting that the 2025 twist in the term structure reflects expectations of a persistent policy response to trade shocks.
papers.summary_zh:
【货币政策与宏观经济】2025年，来自金融市场的通胀预期表现出前所未有的动态变化：一年期通胀互换合约与一年期远期利率之间的相关性首次出现了显著的负相关。我们通过使用由彭博新闻趋势验证的两阶段事件分类方法发现，这种脱钩现象主要发生在关税新闻主导市场定价的时期。传统的、适用于小型开放经济体的新凯恩斯主义模型认为关税会导致一次性的价格水平上升，这些模型预测不同时间段的通胀率应呈现正相关，因此无法解释这一现象。

我们通过修订后的小型开放经济体新凯恩斯主义模型来解释这些现象。在该模型中，有三个关键因素对于再现关税冲击后现货通胀与远期通胀之间的负相关关系至关重要：一是将通胀目标设定为同比通胀率；二是利率具有显著的惯性；三是关税政策会持续实施。在符合实证合理性的参数设定下，该模型能够在考虑关税冲击的情况下预测出负相关关系，同时仍能保持通胀率之间的正无条件相关性。这表明2025年通胀期限结构的变化反映了市场对贸易冲击将引发持续政策反应的预期。。

papers.title: Agentic Artificial Intelligence in Finance: A Comprehensive Survey
papers.abstract: The emergence of agentic artificial intelligence (AI) represents a fundamental transformation in financial markets, characterized by autonomous systems capable of reasoning, planning, and adaptive decision-making with minimal human intervention. This comprehensive survey synthesizes recent advances in agentic AI across multiple dimensions of financial operations, including system architecture, market applications, regulatory frameworks, and systemic implications. We examine how agentic AI differs from traditional algorithmic trading and generative AI through its capacity for goal-oriented autonomy, continuous learning, and multi-agent coordination. Our analysis shows that while agentic AI offers substantial potential for enhanced market efficiency, liquidity provision, and risk management, it also introduces novel challenges related to market stability, regulatory compliance, interpretability, and systemic risk. Through a systematic review of foundational research, technical architectures, market applications, and governance frameworks, this survey provides scholars and practitioners with a structured understanding of how agentic AI is reshaping financial markets and identifies critical research directions for ensuring that these systems enhance both operational efficiency and market resilience.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】代理型人工智能（Agentive Artificial Intelligence, AI）的出现标志着金融市场的一场根本性变革，这类人工智能系统具备自主推理、规划及适应性决策的能力，且几乎不需要人工干预。本综述全面梳理了代理型AI在金融运营多个维度上的最新进展，涵盖系统架构、市场应用、监管框架以及系统影响等方面。我们通过其目标导向的自主性、持续学习能力以及多智能体协同机制，分析了代理型AI与传统算法交易和生成式AI（Generative AI）之间的差异。研究表明，尽管代理型AI在提升市场效率、增加市场流动性及强化风险管理方面具有巨大潜力，但它同时也带来了新的挑战，涉及市场稳定性、合规性、系统可解释性以及系统性风险等问题。通过对基础研究、技术架构、市场应用及治理框架的系统性分析，本文为学者和实践者提供了关于代理型AI如何重塑金融市场的清晰认识，并指出了确保这些系统既能提升运营效率又能增强市场韧性的关键研究方向。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Mitigate or Fail: How Risk Management Shapes Cybersecurity Competency
papers.abstract: Contemporary cybersecurity governance assumes that professionals apply risk reasoning. Yet major organisational failures persist despite investment in tools, staffing, and credentials. This study investigates the structural source of that paradox. Cybersecurity speaks the language of risk, but its training architecture has shaped the profession to think in terms of threats. A sequential mixed-methods design integrated four analyses; NLP of the NIST NICE Framework v2.0.0 (2,111 TKS statements), SEM (n = 126 cybersecurity professionals), a control-group comparison (n = 133 general professionals), and thematic coding of seven leadership interviews. Four convergent findings emerged. First, "likelihood" and "probability" appear zero times across all TKS statements. Risk management content accounts for 4.5% of high-confidence semantic classifications, ranking 18th of 29 competency domains. NICE codifies threat-management activity while invoking risk mainly at the category level. Second, SEM showed that training exposure significantly predicts risk management competence directly and indirectly through conceptual salience, for a total effect of Beta = .629. However, the theoretically four-dimensional competence construct collapsed into a single factor, indicating epistemic compression. Third, cybersecurity professionals showed no measurable advantage over the general professional population in foundational risk reasoning; only 11.9% showed high differentiation. Fourth, all seven leaders expected Likelihood x Impact reasoning, yet five did not articulate the formula themselves. These findings support a structural conclusion: cybersecurity has taken professional form as a threat-management discipline that has borrowed risk vocabulary. Remediation requires redesign of professional formation, not marginal curriculum reform.
papers.summary_zh:
【风险管理与衍生品】当代网络安全治理假定专业人士会运用风险推理方法。然而，尽管在工具、人员配备和资质认证方面投入了大量资源，重大组织性失误仍然频发。本研究旨在探究这一悖论的结构性根源。网络安全领域使用风险相关的语言进行表述，但其培训体系却使从业者习惯于从威胁的角度来思考问题。本研究采用了混合方法设计，包括对NIST NICE Framework v2.0.0（包含2,111条风险描述语句）的自然语言处理分析、对126名网络安全专业人员的深度结构访谈（SEM分析）、与133名普通专业人员的对照组比较，以及对七位领导者的主题编码分析。研究得出了四个主要结论：  

1. 在所有风险描述语句中，“可能性”和“概率”这两个概念均未出现。风险管理相关内容仅占高置信度语义分类的4.5%，在29个能力领域中排名第18位。NICE框架主要将威胁管理活动进行编码，而风险概念仅在较低层次（如类别层面）被提及。  
2. 深度结构访谈显示，培训经历能够显著提升风险管理能力，这种影响既直接体现在能力提升上，也通过概念的显著性间接体现出来（总效应为Beta = 0.629）。然而，理论上应包含四个维度的能力结构实际上被简化为...。研究方法：自然语言处理。

papers.title: Pricing and Hedging Financial Derivatives in Merger\&Acquisition Deals with Price Impact
papers.abstract: We investigate the optimal execution of contracts that are used in merger\&acquisition deals. We consider cash-settled and physically delivered contracts between a broker and a counterpart. Contracts are linear (total returns swaps), nonlinear (collar contracts) or Asian type (TWAP based contracts). We derive the optimal execution strategy and the optimal fee through indifference utility arguments allowing for linear market effects of trades. We show that linear cash-settled contracts are more expensive and more exposed to manipulation/statistical arbitrages by the broker. Also nonlinear and Asian type contracts are exposed to these phenomena.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】我们研究了在并购交易中使用的合约的最优执行方式。我们考虑了经纪人与其交易对手之间以现金结算或实物交付的方式进行的合约。这些合约可以是线性的（总收益互换合约）、非线性的（领口型合约）或亚洲型合约（基于时间加权平均价格（TWAP）的合约）。通过无差异效用理论，并考虑到交易对市场的线性影响，我们推导出了最优执行策略和最优费用。研究发现，线性现金结算合约的成本更高，且更容易受到经纪人操纵或统计套利的影响；非线性和亚洲型合约也同样容易受到这些现象的影响。。

papers.title: Research Streams in Biodiversity Finance: A Bibliometric Analysis and Research Agenda
papers.abstract: Biodiversity loss is accelerating at an unprecedented pace, threatening ecosystem stability, economic resilience, and human well-being, with billions required to reverse current trends. Against this backdrop, biodiversity finance has emerged as a rapidly expanding but highly fragmented field spanning ecology, economics, finance, accounting, and policy. However, it remains emerging and complex, with the majority of relevant knowledge being produced in non-finance journals. This study employs quantitative bibliometric analysis to examine a corpus of 189,456 references underlying 3,998 articles related to biodiversity and finance. The analysis identifies eight primary research streams within the field that concern (1) strategic and financial approaches in global biodiversity conservation, (2) the impact and implementation of payments for environmental services (PES) in developing countries, (3) neoliberal influences and implications in environmental conservation, (4) biodiversity offsets and conservation, (5) ecosystem services and biodiversity, (6) integrating conservation and community interests in biodiversity management, (7) balancing agricultural intensification with biodiversity conservation, and (8) global and corporate biodiversity reporting. The characteristics of each research stream and its prevalent publications are outlined, alongside an analysis of their temporal evolution and the degree of information exchange among the research streams. The findings provide a structured map of the intellectual architecture of biodiversity finance, document pronounced silos between economically-oriented and critical/political-economy research streams, and translate these patterns into a focused research agenda and implications for policymakers, financial institutions, and corporate actors.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】生物多样性的丧失正以前所未有的速度加速，威胁着生态系统的稳定性、经济的韧性以及人类的福祉。要扭转当前的趋势，需要投入巨额资金。在此背景下，生物多样性金融作为一个涵盖生态学、经济学、金融学、会计学和政策领域的新兴学科应运而生，但其发展仍较为分散和复杂，大部分相关研究成果发表在非金融类期刊上。本研究采用定量文献计量分析方法，对189,456篇参考文献（涉及3,998篇关于生物多样性和金融的文章）进行了分析。研究确定了该领域的八个主要研究方向：（1）全球生物多样性保护的战略与金融方法；（2）环境服务支付（PES）在发展中国家的影响与实施；（3）新自由主义思想对环境保护的影响；（4）生物多样性补偿与保护机制；（5）生态系统服务与生物多样性之间的关系；（6）在生物多样性管理中整合保护措施与社区利益；（7）在农业集约化与生物多样性保护之间寻求平衡；（8）全球及企业的生物多样性报告制度。文章概述了每个研究方向的特点及其主要出版物，并分析了它们的发展历程以及各研究方向之间的信息交流程度。研究结果为生物多样性金融的学术体系提供了清晰的框架，揭示了以经济为导向的研究方向与批判性/政治经济学研究方向之...。

papers.title: Nonparametric Point Identification of Treatment Effect Distributions via Rank Stickiness
papers.abstract: Treatment effect distributions are not identified without restrictions on the joint distribution of potential outcomes. Existing approaches either impose rank preservation -- a strong assumption -- or derive partial identification bounds that are often wide. We show that a single scalar parameter, rank stickiness, suffices for nonparametric point identification while permitting rank violations. The identified joint distribution -- the coupling that maximizes average rank correlation subject to a relative entropy constraint, which we call the Bregman-Sinkhorn copula -- is uniquely determined by the marginals and rank stickiness. Its conditional distribution is an exponential tilt of the marginal with a Bregman divergence as the exponent, yielding closed-form conditional moments and rank violation probabilities; the copula nests the comonotonic and Gaussian copulas as special cases. The empirical Bregman-Sinkhorn copula converges at the parametric $\sqrt{n}$-rate with a Gaussian process limit, despite the infinite-dimensional parameter space. We apply the framework to estimate the full treatment effect distribution, derive a variance estimator for the average treatment effect tighter than the Fréchet--Hoeffding and Neyman bounds, and extend to observational studies under unconfoundedness.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在没有对潜在结果的联合分布施加任何限制的情况下，治疗效果的分布是无法被确定的。现有的方法要么强加“秩保持”这一严格假设，要么推导出范围较宽的部分识别界限。我们证明，一个单一的标量参数——即“秩粘性”——就足以实现非参数点的识别，同时允许秩的违反。所识别的联合分布（即在相对熵约束下最大化平均秩相关性的耦合关系）由边际分布和秩粘性唯一确定，我们将其称为Bregman-Sinkhorncopula。其条件分布是边际分布的指数形式，指数部分采用Bregman散度，从而可以计算出封闭形式的条件矩和秩违反概率；该copula包含了共单调copula和高斯copula这两种特殊情况。尽管参数空间是无限维的，但实证研究的Bregman-Sinkhorncopula仍能以$\sqrt{n}$的速率收敛，并具有高斯过程的极限特性。我们利用这一框架来估计完整的治疗效果分布，推导出比Fréchet-Hoeffding和Neyman界限更精确的平均治疗效果方差估计量，并将其扩展到无混杂因素的观察性研究场景中。。

papers.title: COUNTRYWIDE DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION AND EMERGING OPPORTUNITIES FOR THE FINANCIAL SECTOR. THE CASE OF ARMENIA
papers.abstract: We conduct a thematic analysis (TA) of Armenia’s national digital transformation (DT) to assess implications for financial sector development scenarios. Methodologically, we apply a codebook TA using a hybrid deductive–inductive codebook, complemented by select grounded‑theory procedures, drawing on official documents and informants’ public speeches. As a result, we formulate 4 main themes: i) drivers of the countrywide DT vision, ii) actionable steps for implementing countrywide DT, iii) technology policy enablers and iv) technology-enabled financial sector development opportunities. Based on the findings, we argue that while banks are generally expected to maintain their profitability, as the “better bank” scenario is more plausible; however, profitability may come under pressure due to the risks associated with other scenarios (e.g., “distributed bank”).
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】我们对亚美尼亚的国家数字化转型（DT）进行了主题分析（TA），以评估其对金融行业发展前景的影响。在方法论上，我们采用了混合演绎-归纳式的编码手册进行主题分析，并结合了部分扎根理论（grounded theory）的研究方法，同时参考了官方文件和受访者的公开演讲。分析结果归纳出四个主要主题：i) 全国数字化转型愿景的推动力；ii) 实施全国数字化转型的具体步骤；iii) 促进技术发展的政策环境；iv) 技术赋能下的金融行业发展机遇。根据研究结论，我们认为虽然银行总体上仍有望保持盈利能力（因为“更优秀的银行”这一发展路径更为可行），但由于其他发展路径（如“分布式银行”模式）所带来的风险，银行的盈利能力可能会面临压力。。
